Package neqsim.thermodynamicoperations.flashops.saturationops

Class MultiSaltPrecipitation

java.lang.Object
neqsim.thermodynamicoperations.flashops.saturationops.MultiSaltPrecipitation
public final class MultiSaltPrecipitation extends Object
Active-set equilibrium for competing pure COMPSALT minerals.

The operation owns an external non-negative solid ledger. It repeatedly precipitates the most supersaturated mineral or redissolves the most undersaturated present mineral, always using the active thermodynamic system's aqueous activities. Mineral names are sorted so the result is independent of caller ordering.

  • Constructor Details

    • MultiSaltPrecipitation

      public MultiSaltPrecipitation(SystemInterface system, String... requestedMineralNames)
      Creates a simultaneous pure-mineral equilibrium operation.
      Parameters:
      system - thermodynamic system whose dissolved state will be updated
      requestedMineralNames - unique COMPSALT mineral names
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if no mineral is supplied or a name is blank or duplicated

    • MultiSaltPrecipitation

      public MultiSaltPrecipitation(SystemInterface system, MultiSaltPrecipitationResult previousResult)
      Creates a continuation operation with an existing non-negative pure-solid ledger.
      Parameters:
      system - thermodynamic system containing the matching residual dissolved inventory
      previousResult - previous simultaneous-mineral result to re-equilibrate after a state change
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the result is null or contains an invalid solid amount
